answers.core: Improving core `Control` nodes (and giving them basic functionality) should not have to be done by add-ons.  If you're going to have the node at all, why not make it useful out of the box?
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around with *way, way* too many lines of script (about 100 for my limited implementation of drag-and-drop alone, and that took me hours to figure out), including a lot of manually iterating through `TreeItem`s and some ugly hacks.

Also, it would be used only slightly less frequently than `Tree` itself.

title: Make the Tree control node more usable
